trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) WHERE c.city_name <> 'Los Angeles' OR CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) < 1967 RETURN CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS col1, CAST(t.championships AS INT64) AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, t.team_name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
